title: Electrical Architecture & Operational Boundaries
aim: Build a reliable mental model of how electrical energy moves through a mission-critical facility and how operational boundaries change with configuration.

title: Electrical Safety, Roles & Operational Control
aim: Apply established electrical-safety discipline to systems containing multiple sources, stored energy, automation, bypass arrangements and changing commissioning states.

title: HV Distribution, Switchgear, Transformers, Switching & Earthing
aim: Translate familiar HV operational discipline into the architecture and interfaces of a data-centre electrical system.

title: LV Distribution, Earthing, Protection & Multiple Infeeds
aim: Develop the LV system understanding that is often the largest transition for an HV-focused AP/SAP.

title: UPS, Batteries, DC Systems & Bypass
aim: Build UPS understanding from first principles to multi-source operational judgement.

title: ATS / STS, Source Transfer, Coupling & Synchronisation
aim: Understand why alternative sources cannot be treated as interchangeable without considering electrical compatibility and transfer philosophy.

title: Critical Mechanical Electrical Supplies
aim: Understand the electrical dependencies of cooling and environmental systems sufficiently to judge switching consequences and resilience.

title: Commissioning, Temporary Configurations, Load Banks & IST
aim: Develop disciplined configuration awareness when the installed system is being progressively energised, tested or temporarily modified.

title: Protection, Power Quality, Abnormal Conditions & Restoration
aim: Connect protection and power-quality fundamentals to real operational judgement when system state differs from expectation.

title: Integrated Operational Competence & Mock Authorisation
aim: Demonstrate whole-system reasoning across architecture, energy sources, safety, protection, resilience, commissioning and abnormal conditions.
